# `factory/store.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Pipeline orchestration and checks](../../subsystems/pipeline-orchestration-and-checks.md) › `store.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Stores agent exchanges in append-only JSONL ledgers, one ledger per feature. Provides indexing to avoid re-reading entire files on every query, and serialization helpers for pydantic models and other complex types.
